description: Canonical truth ownership for all important operational facts. One source per domain. If two files claim the same fact, this file wins.

ecosystem_index.description: Cross-repo ecosystem map + read-first ordering + boundary/claims guardrail. INDEX ONLY: it points to the per-domain owners below and does NOT own any fact. If the atlas disagrees with a domain owner here, the owner wins.

repo_topology.description: Monorepo layout, subdirectory purposes, org-repo coordination metadata (org_repos), worktree root, K3s cluster IPs. org_repos is repo discovery / coordination metadata, not architectural truth — role/boundary meaning stays with docs/ATLAS.md + ops/state/ecosystem.json, and ops/state/truth/sources.json (this arbiter file, not repo-map.json) wins on truth-ownership conflicts.

sprint_state.description: Active sprint number, tasks, status, blockers. Changes every 1-2 weeks.

merge_policy.description: Required CI checks, merge strategy, readiness definition, admin bypass rules

agent_registry.description: All available agents, their paths, and routing triggers

skill_registry.description: All available skills, their canonical paths, and ownership

downstream_dependency_locks.query: each downstream repo's ops/upstream/icn.lock.yaml, registered in ops/state/config/repo-map.json#org_repos
downstream_dependency_locks.description: Review attestations pinning the ICN ref each downstream repo (nycn, icn-learn, icn-community-bridge) was last reviewed against. Format: icn-upstream-lock/v1 (docs/reference/upstream-lock-format.md). A lock is human-signed once a person fills `reviewer`; a first machine-prepared lock carries `reviewer: pending` with no `reviewed_at` and is registered in org_repos with `lock.review_status: pending-human-signoff` so tooling does NOT treat it as a completed human attestation — icn-learn and icn-community-bridge are in that state today, while nycn carries a human-signed prior review (previous_review). The lock files live in the downstream repos, never in this repo — a lock is a review attestation, not an automated dependency constraint.

cross_repo_pr_stacks.description: Cross-repo PR merge order and per-stack state: machine-readable stack manifests (<slug>.stack.yaml, format icn-pr-stack/v1, validated by scripts/check-pr-stack.sh). ops/coordination/PR_STACK_PROTOCOL.md documents the discipline; the manifests own stack state. Coordination metadata only — plan/order facts, never runtime or readiness truth.

adr_decisions.description: Architecture Decision Records. Canonical under docs/adr/. Naming: ADR-NNNN-kebab-case-title.md. Never delete; use status: superseded.

cluster_topology.description: K3s node IPs, service ports. Source: repo-map.json .infrastructure.k3s

invariants.description: The 5 non-negotiable protocol invariants. Never override.

ci_exceptions.description: Documented CI exemptions with rationale and expiry

live_branch_state.description: Current branch, dirty files, uncommitted changes. NEVER hardcode.

live_pr_state.description: Open PRs and their CI state. NEVER hardcode.

forbidden: Do NOT hardcode sprint numbers in skills or agents — read ops/state/sprint/current.json
Do NOT hardcode PR numbers or branch lists — query via gh
Do NOT hardcode cluster IPs — read from repo-map.json#infrastructure
Do NOT use icn-ops/state paths — canonical is ops/state/ (inside monorepo)
Do NOT use icn-website/ paths — canonical is website/ (inside monorepo)
Do NOT reference sync-from-icn.sh — the website reads docs directly
